_comment: Retro run only. baseline is set ONCE from live quotes (SPY/QQQ/SMH) plus account value, then never edited - every rebased number depends on it. series holds raw closes; the board rebases.

baseline.source: Regular-session opening bars, 2026-08-04 13:30:00Z (9:30 ET), pulled from the brokerage market-data API. Not the interpolated daily bars for that date, which carry zero volume and were stale by $13.66 on SPY. Account value is the documented open figure - cash plus premium held before the first fill - not a rounded $100.
baseline.note: The baseline is the 8/4 open, which places it BEFORE the pre-mandate AMD call. That trade was entered by hand, graded 0/6 on the checklist, and returned +40.8%. Account performance measured from this baseline therefore includes a result the agent did not produce and the retro judged a process failure. The first sessions of this chart flatter the account by roughly 27 points against SMH for that reason alone.

series.source: Official settled closes read 2026-08-05 00:55 ET, after settlement. Each carried source 'sip-list-exchange-close' with interpolated=false - the explicit check against the daily-bar failure mode that was stale by $13.66 on SPY. Account value is the brokerage's own total for the session, not a figure derived from the trade.
